reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend like getUpcomingDates does, but re-derives the daily-weekend-skip rule that getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts already encodes.

duplication.why: The 'daily schedules skip weekend occurrences, others shift' decision is re-implemented inline as a second copy of the rule in getNextDate rather than extracted and shared.

placement.why: Handler lives in schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates and is registered the same way; the weekend-rule part arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, an import and tests.

maintainability.why: Compact but the daily-vs-shift weekend rule now lives in two places, and the dense flatMap/Set/sort chain with a magic 3-day window is harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getDateWithSkippedWeekend for shifting; no existing abstraction for the daily skip rule is bypassed (there is none to call).

disguised_duplication.where: schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange: `isDaily && config.skipWeekend && d.isWeekend(date)` skip plus `isDaily ? date : getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...)` reshapes the same rule getNextDate applies in shared/schedules.ts.
